verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a self-hosted deployment option that runs inside the customer's own cloud or on-premises environment (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, OpenShift). That gives customers control over where their data lives. However, nothing in the evidence describes region or data-residency selection for the hosted SaaS, so residency control appears to come only through self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented region/residency choice for the hosted service, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees, details of which data stays in a self-hosted environment, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run Mintlify inside your own cloud or on-premises environment, on AWS or any Kubernetes platform including Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, and OpenShift.
